Ardent Qu'th is a member of  Inquisitor W'wargaz's retinue during Act One.
“
Our mission is urgent, and our time short. Do not waste it.
„
— Qu'th

Involvement

Act One

Qu'th stands stoically alongside W'wargaz in the Inquisitor's Chamber of Crèche Y'llek. He is mildly impressed by the party's ability to earn an audience with the inquisitor.

He becomes hostile to the party if they refuse to hand over the Mysterious Artefact, or if they progress far enough in ⁠The Githyanki Warrior.
